name: sidar_horseman
description: a Sidar Horseman (Fall from Heaven), a pale rider in a tattered dark grey hooded cloak over steel scale mail, a round grey steel shield with a white crescent on his RIGHT arm on the screen-left side and a spear with a steel blade raised in his LEFT hand on the screen-right side, riding a pale grey-white horse with a dark grey mane and tail and brown leather tack
hands: the spear stays in the rider's left hand on the screen-right side and the round crescent shield on his right arm on the screen-left side
